listing.name: Flight Panel
listing.abstract: A window with live flight data, and a warp guard that limits time warp at low altitude.
listing.description:
Flight Panel adds a window with live flight data and a warp guard that keeps time warp in check at low altitude.

![The Flight panel in orbit around Earth, with its settings open](ksa-image:panel)

- **Flight data:** altitude, height above ground, vertical, surface and orbital speed, apoapsis and periapsis with countdowns, mass, propellant, throttle and time warp, plus the highest and fastest your vehicle has been.
- **Warp guard:** below an altitude you set (70 km by default), time warp can't go past a speed you set (4x by default), and the game's auto-warp won't start.
- **Settings** in the panel, saved across games.
- **F7** shows and hides the panel, **F6** turns the warp guard on and off. Both are in the game's **Mods** menu too.

Flight Panel is written in Rust and runs on [Oxidizer](https://github.com/SafeShows/Oxidizer), which mod managers install with it. It is also a worked example for modders: each source file shows one part of Oxidizer's API, and its MIT-0 license lets you copy any of it into your own mods.
